prompt: Create a polished anime-style illustration of two young adult women collaboratively composing music in a cozy pastel pink bedroom. The scene is warm, intimate, and softly lit by sunlight from a window on the left with pink curtains. The characters sit kneeling on a plush pink carpet around a low round white table, facing each other in conversation. The left woman, Otome, has long dark brown hair in a high side ponytail with loose bangs, large brown eyes, and wears a light blue frilly camisole nightdress with lace trim; she holds a pink pen over handwritten sheet music and looks thoughtfully at her partner. The right woman, Airi, has shoulder-length medium brown hair with soft bangs, large brown eyes, and wears a fitted white V-neck T-shirt with a tiny pink bow detail and high-waisted pale pink cargo pants; she holds a black pen and gestures with her other hand as if explaining a melody idea. On the table show exactly 8 main items: two open notebooks filled with musical staff notation, one loose sheet of music paper, one pink pen, one black pen, one pink mesh pencil cup packed with pens, one glass of iced tea, and one stacked set of pastel books. Add a pink smartphone lying near the front edge of the table. Include a small electronic keyboard partly visible on the floor at the lower left, plus scattered lyric sheets on the carpet. The background is a cute feminine bedroom: pink walls, white bed with pink gingham blanket and large teddy bear on the right, vanity desk with mirror in the center back, shelves with cosmetics and small objects, framed photos, vines, and music-note wall decorations including a treble clef. Use soft bloom lighting, delicate shading, high-detail glossy anime rendering, pastel color palette, gentle romantic-comedy atmosphere, clean composition, realistic room depth, and no explicit nudity. Keep all visible writing as decorative handwritten music notation rather than readable lyrics or text.
